@layer properties;
@layer theme, base, components, utilities;
@layer theme {
  :root, :host {
    --font-sans: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, sans-serif;
    --color-zinc-950: oklch(14.1% 0.005 285.823);
    --spacing: 1px;
    --radius-lg: 0.5rem;
    --default-font-family: var(--font-sans);
  }
}
@layer base {
  *, ::after, ::before, ::backdrop, ::file-selector-button {
    box-sizing: border-box;
    border: 0 solid;
  }
  html, :host {
    line-height: 1.5;
    -webkit-text-size-adjust: 100%;
  }
  abbr:where([title]) {
    text-decoration: underline dotted;
  }
  @supports (not (-webkit-appearance: -apple-pay-button))  or (contain-intrinsic-size: 1px) {
    ::placeholder {
      color: currentcolor;
      @supports (color: color-mix(in lab, red, red)) {
        color: color-mix(in oklab, currentcolor 50%, transparent);
      }
    }
  }
  button, input:where([type='button'], [type='reset']) {
    appearance: button;
  }
}
@layer utilities {
  .bg-zinc-950\/90 {
    background-color: color-mix(in srgb, oklch(14.1% 0.005 285.823) 90%, transparent);
  }
  .px-2 {
    padding-inline: calc(var(--spacing) * 2);
  }
  .rounded-full {
    border-radius: calc(infinity * 1px);
  }
  .shadow-md {
    --tw-shadow: 0 4px 6px -1px var(--tw-shadow-color, rgb(0 0 0 / 0.1));
    box-shadow: var(--tw-inset-shadow), var(--tw-shadow);
  }
  .blur-sm {
    filter: var(--tw-blur,) var(--tw-brightness,);
  }
  @media (hover: hover) {
    .hover\:bg-zinc-800:hover {
      background-color: var(--color-zinc-800);
    }
  }
  .data-\[selected\=true\]\:bg-zinc-800[data-selected="true"] {
    background-color: var(--color-zinc-800);
  }
  @media (width >= 48rem) {
    .md\:flex-row {
      flex-direction: row;
    }
  }
}
@property --tw-translate-x {
  syntax: "*";
  inherits: false;
  initial-value: 0;
}
